subject.title: fix(lmstudio): respect embedding preload context limits

question: Should maintainers salvage this branch by rebasing/fixing the broad diff, or extract the LM Studio embedding-context fix into a narrow current-main PR?
rationale: The central LM Studio fix is good, but the current branch is conflicting, unmergeable as-is, and carries unrelated compatibility-sensitive surfaces that need maintainer ownership.

options.title: Extract a narrow LM Studio fix
options.body: Create or refresh a current-main PR that keeps only the LM Studio embedding-provider change, focused tests, and live-proof context, then close or supersede the broad branch.

options.title: Rebase and repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing vehicle, but first rebase it onto current main, resolve conflicts, remove unrelated drift, and fix or explicitly defer the browser extension auth issue.

options.title: Hold for owner review
options.body: Leave the PR open until the maintainer owner decides whether the branch should carry the extra browser/UI/plugin changes or be split.

recommendation.title: Extract a narrow LM Studio fix
recommendation.body: Create or refresh a current-main PR that keeps only the LM Studio embedding-provider change, focused tests, and live-proof context, then close or supersede the broad branch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this PR and owns the recent browser extension relay history that creates the main merge-readiness risk.
